method: Opens saved v13 then v14 in the Editor (no Play Mode, no saves). Objects are matched by name path plus occurrence ordinal so the regenerated Terrain child's new sibling index does not mask changes. Serialized fields are compared through SerializedProperty values, object references by scene path or asset path. Collision uses edit-mode Physics raycasts against saved colliders; route corridor = v13 route profile at +/-5.4 m (8.8 m deck plus margin), margin band = 5.4-12 m; cover = horizontal rays at 1.0 m and 2.5 m above the route surface out to 25 m.
